name: apsw-gridwright
description: Headless, component-oriented data grid for TypeScript with a React table component. One pipeline for local arrays and remote endpoints, negotiated through data-source capabilities. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT.

paragraphs: Live demo: every add-on, switchable, over a mock API that runs in your browser, plus a six-step quickstart.

The React data grid that does not care where your rows live. Hand it an array today and a paginating API tomorrow: the columns, the add-ons and every prop but one stay exactly as they were. Sorting, filtering, search, paging, selection, export, a tree, inline editing, column layout and ten million rows, accessible by default, translated into five languages, typed end to end, with zero runtime dependencies. MIT.

underneath it is headless and separately importable, with no DOM and no runtime dependencies, which is why the component is small and why the pipeline is testable without a renderer. It is the engine of this package, not a second way to build a grid.
features: React is the supported surface. apsw-gridwright/react is what you build with. The engine
Accessible by default. A real with role="grid", sort state on the header cell,
Unstyled. Structural CSS driven entirely by custom properties.
One component, and every feature is an add-on. is a shell: a table, its rows,
Extensible below the renderer too. Sorting, filtering, search and pagination are engine
